description: This Java class defines an Android activity that manages a ListView with animated insertion of new list items, including handling button interactions and custom animations.

classes.name: InsertingCells
classes.description: An Android activity that manages a list with animated row insertions and image animations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the list, button, and animation components.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Handles the button click to add a new item to the list with optional animation.

methods.name: onRowAdditionAnimationStart
methods.description: Callback invoked when row addition animation starts; disables the button.

methods.name: onRowAdditionAnimationEnd
methods.description: Callback invoked when row addition animation ends; re-enables the button.
